# Sodales announced as the first Premium Certified Endorsed App with SAP GENAI Hub and SAP AI Core – transforming the vision of a healthy and respectful workplace - Sodales Solutions

Toronto, ON – October 22, 2024 – Sodales is thrilled to announce its official status as the First Premium Certified Endorsed App utilizing the SAP GENAI Hub and SAP AI Core, seamlessly integrating with Employee Central. This strategic certification marks a revolutionary step in leveraging artificial intelligence to enhance workplace safety, ensure compliance and streamline employee relations.
Enhancing Workplace Safety with Business AI
Sodales’ innovative use of SAP’s Business AI capabilities addresses a vital market need by enhancing workplace safety and preventing labor disputes. This integration significantly boosts employee retention and productivity while reducing absenteeism, particularly in skilled labor markets. This use case empowers organizations to proactively mitigate risks and foster a culture of accountability.
“By harnessing the power of SAP Business AI for safety and labor regulatory compliance, organizations can proactively mitigate risks and instill a culture of accountability,” said Darryl Gray, Global Vice President – SAP Software Partner Innovation Success. “We value our partnership with Sodales in embracing these powerful technologies to bring world class solutions to our mutual customers to stay at the forefront of innovation together.”
Addressing Urgent Compliance Needs
In today’s labor climate, where whistleblower cases are on the rise, companies face an urgent need to provide employees with systems to promptly report safety and compliance issues. Sodales addresses these challenges by offering an Enterprise Health, Safety and Employee Relations software enabled by SAP Business AI. This software empowers employees to report safety incidents, grievances, employee relations complaints and more ensuring the right parties are involved to help companies protect their reputations.
“Business AI transforms the vision of a healthy and respectful workplace into a tangible reality,” exclaims Sana Salam, CEO of Sodales. “This announcement marks a significant step forward in our commitment to providing organizations with intelligent tools to foster a healthy and respectful workplace across the employee experience.”
Moving forward, Sodales remains dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what is possible in enhancing workplace compliance through technology and AI. Sodales’ goal is to not only meet the needs of today’s organizations but also to anticipate the challenges of tomorrow, ensuring that businesses are equipped to navigate the complexities of health, safety and employee relations with confidence and efficiency. With the integration of SAP’s robust Business AI capabilities, Sodales is redefining the standards for workplace safety and compliance, setting a new benchmark for the industry.
Learn more about Sodales and their BTP-EXT-GENAI certified application proudly built on SAP Business technology here.
